risks: 43 authored tests have never been executed in this environment; regression risk is carried by the coordinator's re-verification on the fixed commit.
Static reparse-point refusal does not close hostile concurrent directory replacement (TOCTOU); real NAS semantics and power-loss durability are unverified.
contracts/media-package/candidate-v1 is a task fixture only (task_fixture_only), not a production publication contract; semantic changes there require fixture and vocabulary updates.

The private NuGet cache was seeded by a one-way copy from another task; it is only trusted because all 50 in-solution locked packages independently matched the lock contentHash and the .nupkg byte digest.
